name: project-color
description: A colour per project: a full-width stripe in the repo's colour above the prompt (stacked over other bands), a colour-emoji status line for mobile, and /color to pin or reset the colour per repo.

stripe.title: Show stripe
stripe.description: Draw the full-width project stripe above the prompt (terminal and desktop).

thickness.title: Stripe thickness
thickness.description: Rows the stripe takes: 1, or 2 for a thicker bar (falls back to 1 when the band is short).

branch.title: Show branch
branch.description: Show the checked-out git branch, dim, at the right end of the stripe (read from .git/HEAD).

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Pin a status entry such as '🟣 modemon' under the prompt; it is the colour's only sign on the Claude mobile app.
